title: A flow sequence replaced by a list stays a flow sequence
notes: The replaced value keeps its style when that style can hold the new value (docs/edit-semantics.md, The value keeps its style); a flow sequence holds any list. Members are separated by `, `. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend kept the flow style; the native backend rewrote the value as a block sequence.
